## Professional Overview
- **Founder, Dharmasthan** (https://dharmasthan.in): A modern collaborative digital platform for Hindu devotion. Offers synchronized live aarti rooms (where every phone follows the leader's stanza), free customizable websites for mandals, and a centralized directory of festival competitions. Founded alongside co-founder Jay Patil; served over 2,000 devotees in its initial 45 days. Awarded three national first prizes in 2026.
- **AI Engineering Intern, DeployProAI** (May 2026 – Present): Architects production-grade autonomous AI agents, LLM backends, and full-stack solutions for enterprise clients.
- **Vice-Chairperson, Sardar Patel Consulting Group** (Aug 2026 – Present): Oversees student consultancy engagements across research, finance, and technology for 7+ corporate clients.
- **Technology & Automation Associate, IGT India Gold Trading** (Sep 2023 – Feb 2026): Streamlined operations through 10 custom automations (40% reduction in manual effort), increased site speed by 35%, and supported pipelines generating 2,000+ qualified leads.
